reviews.rationale: Sequential comparison of selected GAAP exhibit rows shows revenue, operating income, attributable net income and diluted EPS all higher in the later quarter, with both compensation and non-compensation cost lines also higher. The profit expansion therefore occurred alongside cost growth rather than through cost reduction, and the selected rows do not decompose revenue by business line, client mix or advisory versus underwriting activity, nor do they separate GAAP from company-defined adjusted measures. No source-backed driver fact is available to attribute the profit change, so the sequential arithmetic is treated as descriptive only. Because the extract lacks the drivers, segment detail, adjusted measures, guidance and prior-year comparatives needed to judge durability, the research state is held for review rather than upgraded.
